description: Search file contents with a regular expression (ripgrep syntax), respecting .gitignore. Prefer this over grep or rg in the shell. `output_mode` picks file paths (default), matching lines, or counts per file.

pattern.description: Literal braces need escaping, like interface\{\}.

path.description: The file or directory to search. Default is the working directory.

glob.description: Searches only files matching this glob, like *.rs.

context.description: Lines shown before and after each match in content mode.

head_limit.description: Results to show at most. Default 250. 0 means no limit.
